what_this_pilot_can_and_cannot_establish.can: EXECUTABILITY, as a yes/no. Does an at-touch maker complement actually fill inside the 120s completion runway, where the two-tick complement provably could not (the 1445z defect: own 0.6000 posted into a 0.6200 bid, behind the entire visible queue, unfillable by construction)?
what_this_pilot_can_and_cannot_establish.cannot: PROFITABILITY. Four windows at a 1-contract clip is at most 4 completed pairs. The established loss driver is FIRST-LEG ADVERSE SELECTION -- 4 of 4 prior windows, complement monotonically dearer (0.78->0.99, 0.60->0.92, 0.55->0.96, 0.77->0.94) -- and at-touch completion does not address it. This pilot has essentially no power to separate the two policies on P&L.
what_this_pilot_can_and_cannot_establish.do_not_expect: any movement toward the $480/day target from four 1-contract windows. Maximum gross cash at risk is bounded at $12 and realized loss at $5.
what_this_pilot_can_and_cannot_establish.honest_framing: an executability probe, not a profitability test. Worth running for the yes/no; not worth reading as evidence about expectancy.
